Refactor applied across the model, simulation, and UI layers.

What changed:
- `[Entity.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Entity.java)`, `[Plant.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Plant.java)`, `[Prey.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Prey.java)`, and `[Predator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Predator.java)` now use a template-method style `placeAt(...)` hook instead of `instanceof` dispatch in the base class.
- `[Simulator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Simulator.java)` is broken into smaller helpers for population setup, animal/plant updates, time-cycle updates, and sickness calculation.
- `Simulator.reset()` now clears both animals and plants, which prevents stale plant instances from accumulating across runs.
- `Simulator` now guards against division by zero when the animal population drops to zero.
- `[FieldStats.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/FieldStats.java)` uses generics and a simpler count model.
- `[GraphView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/GraphView.java)` now uses a deterministic `LinkedHashMap` order and simpler iteration.
- Small cleanup improvements landed in `[Field.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Field.java)`, `[Location.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Location.java)`, `[Counter.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Counter.java)`, `[Gender.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Gender.java)`, `[TimeCycle.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/TimeCycle.java)`, and `[SimulatorView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/SimulatorView.java)`.

Verification:
- `javac *.java` passed cleanly.

Residual risk:
- I validated compilation only; I did not run the Swing simulation end-to-end in this session.
